summary.text: Corey Paris is a Democratic and Working Families Party member of the Connecticut House of Representatives from District 145 who took office on May 4, 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Paris was re-elected on November 5, 2024, defeating Republican Fritz Blau, 75.8 percent to 24.2 percent.
The August 11, 2026 Democratic primary for the seat was canceled, and Republican Andrew Krill advanced from a likewise canceled Republican primary.
For 2025 and 2026 he was vice chair of the Appropriations Committee, co-chair of the Children Committee and a member of the Higher Education and Employment Committee.
